title: Dimensional Rift
next_chapter_hook: When that rift that distorts time and space pointed toward an ancient and terrifying existence, Chen Ji finally realized—this dimensional invasion might have been a carefully designed chess game from the very beginning.

text.content: A trace of almost imperceptible guilt flickered across Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, only to be completely devoured by the sudden violent disturbance of the Tianji Record. Those fragmented pages trembled violently like living creatures, golden Tianji patterns flashing frantically, as if responding to a catastrophe capable of tearing apart the Three Realms. The burning刺痛 on Chen Ji's fingertips—the power of the Tianji Record had never been this out of control before.

In the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the restriction at the intersection of the Three Realms suddenly shattered. A thousand-zhang rift tore open the heavens, its edges not ordinary obsidian but countless twisted rays of light and shattered dimensions stacked together. Dimensional degradation spread like ink in water, spreading outward from the rift's center. Where it passed, green mountains became flat planes, flowing water condensed into thin sheets, and mortal buildings twisted into impossible geometric fragments.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! This is... dimensional degradation? Impossible, the ancient seal should have held for at least three hundred more years!

text.content: Su Qingyao came on her sword, the garments of the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow fluttering violently in the otherworldly gale. Her face was pale as paper—as one of the most powerful members of the Tianqing Sect, she actually felt a soul-shredding pressure emanating from that rift. Dimensional creatures had begun pouring from the breach, formless, just clumps of gray nothingness eroding reality.

dialogue.content: Three hundred years? Someone couldn't wait any longer.

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the Tianji Record into his sleeve, his expression so indifferent it seemed he was facing nothing more than a trivial flash flood. His gaze pierced through the dimensional rift, seeing the terrifying existence deep within watching the mortal world. Heavenly Eyes—that was a gaze transcending dimensions. Chen Ji swore that in that instant, he and those无形 eyes gazed at each other for a full breath's time.

dialogue.content: Don't zone out! There are three thousand mortals at the foot of the mountain, there's no time to evacuate them!

text.content: The speed of dimensional degradation far exceeded expectations. Villages at the mountain's base had begun to dissolve—not destruction, but literally 'dimensional reduction.' Houses had their third dimension stripped away, becoming flat paintings spread across the ground. Villagers stared in terror as their bodies grew thinner. Someone screamed while reaching out, only to touch family members who were also becoming flat. Wailing and screaming interwove into an earthly hell.

Finally, Chen Ji moved. The Tianji Record sent a final trace of warmth from his sleeve—that was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul unlocking a new page in this critical moment. 'The power of the game-breaker, four-dimensional perception...' Chen Ji murmured. His pupils suddenly dyed in silver-white. In an instant, he saw what ordinary people couldn't: every spreading node of dimensional degradation, every erosion vein, and... the existence at the rift's source that was enjoying this destruction.

choice.prompt: The nodes of dimensional degradation were clearly visible. Destroying just one could temporarily delay the spread—but Chen Ji's four-dimensional perception told him that numerous dimensional creatures lurked around each node, and every use of the Tianji Record's abilities consumed precious Heavenly Fate.

choices.text: Go all out to destroy the nodes
choices.description: Consume 15 Heavenly Fate, use four-dimensional perception to blast the erosion nodes with full force, destroying the spreading core before dimensional creatures encircle.
choices.visible_reward: Prevent dimensional degradation within a ten-li radius, unlock achievement 'Game-Breaker Emerges'
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption is massive, and may expose the Tianji Record's existence

dialogue.content: Since that's the case—shatter for me!

text.content: Silver light exploded outward. Chen Ji himself became like a divine sword tearing through dimensions. Guided by four-dimensional perception, his attack precisely struck the erosion node's core—a gray singularity constantly devouring reality. With a thunderous boom, the singularity collapsed. The spread of dimensional degradation suddenly halted. Villagers stared in dazed relief as their bodies slowly recovered from their flat state. That gratitude of surviving death almost overflowed.

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶见证陈机爆发真实力

choices.text: Preserve strength to save mortals only
choices.description: Consume no Heavenly Fate, rely solely on martial techniques and movement to rescue mortals that can be saved in the dimensional degradation, abandon destroying the nodes.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve all Heavenly Fate, but erosion will spread to a larger area
choices.risk_hint: Abandoning nodes may lead to greater crises later

dialogue.content: Heavenly Fate cannot be used lightly... Senior Sister Su, come with me to save people.

text.content: Chen Ji's figure surged forward, carrying out rescues at the edge of the dimensional degradation. He precisely judged the exact moment each building lost its third dimension, dragging out the mortals inside before collapse. Su Qingyao followed closely behind. The two worked in perfect sync, saving dozens of villagers in a single breath. But Chen Ji knew in his heart—the node he abandoned was eroding a distant mountain range at an even faster rate.

choices.memory_label: 陈机选择以凡人生命为先

choices.text: Sacrifice the local area to preserve nodes
choices.description: Abandon the nearest village, concentrate all strength to destroy erosion nodes, trading space for time.
choices.visible_reward: Consume 5 Heavenly Fate to destroy nodes, prevent greater area disaster
choices.risk_hint: Will be viewed as standing by and watching people die, a cold-blooded decision

dialogue.content: No time left... everyone listen, evacuate eastward, don't look back!

text.content: Chen Ji's voice spread across the area, yet carried a chilling indifference. He turned and charged toward the node, letting the village behind him completely flatten in the dimensional degradation. Three hundred mortals, three hundred lives—in his calculations just 'acceptable losses.' Su Qingyao's eyes widened—she had never seen Chen Ji like this. That servant disciple who was always gentle and polite before her was now as cold as a machine without emotions.

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶目睹陈机冷血抉择

text.content: The moment the node was destroyed, the dimensional creatures let out piercing shrieks. Like newborns with severed umbilical cords, they had lost their connection to the source and began attacking everything around them indiscriminately. In the chaos, Chen Ji's four-dimensional perception caught a crucial detail—the dimensional creatures' assault wasn't disordered. Their attack route precisely drew an arc across the Tianqing Sect's protective mountain formation, as if clearing a path for someone.

dialogue.content: What a clever 'openly repair the plank road while secretly crossing the Wei River' maneuver... Who's inside?

text.content: The Tianji Record flipped on its own. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul appeared on the pages, his aged voice carrying unprecedented gravity: 'Dimensional degradation is merely the surface. The true target is the Tianqing Sect's treasure of treasures—the Heavenly Fragment. Someone wants to use the dimensional invasion to open the seal and steal it.' Chen Ji's gaze hardened. 'Who?' Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment before finally uttering two words: 'Ling Yuan.'

The old sect master's name was like thunder exploding in Chen Ji's ears. Everything made sense—Ling Yuan's 'protection' of the Tianqing Sect, every time he appeared to help at critical moments, was merely setting the stage for today. He wanted the Tianqing Sect to owe him favors, wanted to make himself indispensable, then at the most crucial moment... take everything back with interest.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji... your expression is terrible... what did you discover?

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao was waiting for Chen Ji's answer. Though the dimensional rift was temporarily suppressed, it continued slowly expanding. Ling Yuan's conspiracy had surfaced. Chen Ji had to decide whether to tell Su Qingyao the truth.

choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao everything Mo Xiansheng said: Ling Yuan's conspiracy and the true purpose of the dimensional invasion.
choices.visible_cost: Expose some of the Tianji Record's abilities
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's full cooperation, trust between the two reaches new heights
choices.risk_hint: May provoke Su Qingyao's hostility toward the old sect master, causing internal sect turmoil

dialogue.content: Senior Sister, what I'm about to say might overturn everything you know about the Tianqing Sect. But I hope after hearing it, you won't act rashly.

text.content: Chen Ji laid out Mo Xiansheng's deduction, Ling Yuan's ambition, the truth about the Heavenly Fragment. Su Qingyao's expression shifted from shock to ashen, then from ashen to a complex calm. She was the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, holding instinctive reverence for the old sect master. But at this moment, that reverence was collapsing. 'I understand.' Her voice was soft, yet carried a resolute determination. 'What do we do?'

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶正式成为陈机对抗凌渊的盟友

choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao that someone is taking advantage of the chaos, but don't mention Ling Yuan's name, giving her a 'direction to investigate.'
choices.visible_reward: Maintain information advantage, not expose the full scope of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best opportunity to respond

dialogue.content: Someone wants to steal the sect's secret treasure during this invasion. Senior Sister, you know the sect's internal affairs better than I... has anyone been acting suspiciously lately?

text.content: Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly. Chen Ji's words gave her direction but not an answer. She began recalling recent strange occurrences within the sect: the old sect master's closed-door life-and-death cultivation, the 'routine maintenance' of the protective mountain formation, and those 'coincidentally' appearing reinforcements at critical moments... Her gaze gradually sharpened. 'I understand.' She said deeply. 'I'll investigate.'

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶开始独自调查宗门内部

text.content: The residual power of four-dimensional perception allowed Chen Ji to see even more—deep within the rift, the existence bathed in Heavenly Eyes was slowly retreating. Not defeated, but having completed its mission. The chaos caused by the dimensional invasion was enough to cover the next move. The Heavenly Fragment... what Ling Yuan coveted, Chen Ji would never let him obtain.

dialogue.content: Child, you did well. But this chess game is far more complex than you imagined... Ling Yuan is merely one piece. The Heavenly Eyes—that is the true hand moving the pieces.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's words were like ice water poured down. The Heavenly Eyes—that transcendent consciousness was finally making its move. Dimensional invasion was merely reconnaissance. The true killing blow was still to come. Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record tightly, feeling the remaining power fluctuations within. Heavenly Fate had been consumed considerably, but he knew—this was only the beginning. When the dimensional rift completely closed, the fate of the entire Tianqing Sect would be rewritten.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji... who exactly are you?

text.content: Su Qingyao's question echoed in his ears, but Chen Ji didn't answer immediately. He only gazed at the dimensional rift slowly healing in the sky, at those eyes that had vanished from within the rift yet still seemed to be watching. The Heavenly Eyes. At this moment, Chen Ji finally understood the true meaning of the Tianji Record's existence—it wasn't a tool to prophecy the future, but the only weapon against such transcendent existences. But... what was the price for the user? The fleeting guilt in Mo Xiansheng's eyes might be part of the answer.

When the dimensional rift completely vanished from the horizon, Chen Ji turned to look at Su Qingyao, wearing a warm, harmless smile: 'Senior Sister, I'm just a servant disciple.' That smile was no different from before, yet Su Qingyao felt something had changed. This man she had deemed 'useless' revealed for the first time a hint of the extraordinary—a depth that was terrifying,沉淀ed through the chess game and now terrifying in its profoundness.
